title: Heated inclusion in a free disc: eigenstrain stress and Lame decay outside (analytic)
description:
Quarter of a free solid disc (radius b = 1 mm, one material, steel-like E 200 GPa, nu 0.3, alpha 1.2e-5; void outside) whose central core r < a is heated by dT = 100 K (temperature_change feature on the inclusion only, no heat physics): the core wants to expand, the ring around it holds it back (the stress of a shrink fit). Rollers on x_lo / y_lo are the symmetry lines, the disc rim is free. Plane strain; the sweep runs a / b over 0.2, 0.4, 0.6.
Analytic (plane strain, eps_zz = 0; K = alpha E dT / (2 (1 - nu)), rho = a^2 / b^2): inside the core a uniform hydrostatic state sigma_r = sigma_theta = -K (1 - rho), sigma_zz = -2 nu K (1 - rho) - E alpha dT; outside sigma_r = -K a^2 (1/r^2 - 1/b^2), sigma_theta = K a^2 (1/r^2 + 1/b^2) (the Lame 1/r^2 decay plus a uniform tension 2 K rho in sigma_r + sigma_theta), sigma_zz = 2 nu K rho; sigma_theta jumps by 2 K at r = a, sigma_r is continuous. u_r = C r (1 + (1 - 2 nu) rho) inside and C a^2 (1/r + (1 - 2 nu) r / b^2) outside with C = (1 + nu) alpha dT / (2 (1 - nu)), so the rim moves by u_r(b) = (1 + nu) alpha dT a^2 / b.
Both circles are staircases of 128 cells per b: the inclusion area (and every quantity ~ a^2) is off by a few 1e-3 (more at a / b = 0.2: ~26 cells per radius), and the cell or two at the inclusion edge scatter.
Derived values tab: sxx_core / syy_core / szz_core (means over r < a / 2, ~1e-3), sum_outside (mean of sigma_xx + sigma_yy over the ring a + 4 dx < r < b - 4 dx vs 2 K rho, ~1 %) and u_rim (probe in the rim cell on the x axis, ~1 %).
Sweep tab: sxx_core and sum_outside vs a / b with their dashed curves.
Line profile tab (last sweep value, a / b = 0.6), half a cell above the x axis: sigma_r_axis (solid.stress_xx through core and ring), sigma_theta_ring (solid.stress_yy, the ring only, starting 3 cells outside the inclusion), sigma_z_axis (solid.stress_zz, with the E alpha dT step) and u_radial (solid.u_x); expected ~1-2 % of each curve's range.

parameters.name: dT
parameters.description: temperature change of the inclusion in K (the ring stays at the stress-free temperature)

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (128 cells per disc radius)

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: side of the quarter model (disc plus a 4-cell void margin)

parameters.name: K_th
parameters.description: plane-strain eigenstress scale K in Pa (171 MPa)

parameters.name: x_rim
parameters.description: rim probe x: centre of the last disc cell on the x axis

parameters.name: u_rim_ref
parameters.description: analytic u_x at the rim probe in m (~(1 + nu) alpha dT a^2 / b)

analytic_curves.name: sigma_r_axis
analytic_curves.expression: where(x**2 + y**2 < a_incl**2, -K_th*(1 - rho_a), K_th*rho_a + K_th*a_incl**2*(y**2 - x**2)/(x**2 + y**2)**2)

analytic_curves.name: u_radial
analytic_curves.expression: where(x**2 + y**2 < a_incl**2, C_u*x*(1 + (1 - 2*nu_disc)*rho_a), C_u*a_incl**2*x*(1/(x**2 + y**2) + (1 - 2*nu_disc)/b_disc**2))
